definitionZh: 集装箱短手CSS属性确定该元素为查询容器,并具体说明集装箱查询中使用的封装上下文的名称和类型.
sourceDefinition: The container shorthand CSS property establishes the element as a query container and specifies the name and type of the containment context used in a container query.
